extension_properties.name: Source authority non-transfer
extension_properties.assertion: Binding, staging, projecting or planning a CodexStation/Evidence Router object has zero DFT authority effect until an explicit typed target commit is accepted.

extension_properties.name: Per-claim kind projection
extension_properties.assertion: Noncanonical source kinds are resolved only by a source-claim-specific reviewed projection record; no global semantic equivalence is inferred.

extension_properties.name: Dependency transfer explicitness
extension_properties.assertion: A target claim commit is admitted only after every declared source dependency has already been explicitly committed and mapped in topological order.

extension_properties.name: Evidence Router lossless staging
extension_properties.assertion: All source partitions stage with deterministic row hashes and raw authority/status values unchanged.

extension_properties.name: S013 semantic parity
extension_properties.assertion: Bridge impact and non-mutating retraction results match the frozen S013 engine for parity cases.

extension_properties.name: Unknown HTTP routes fail closed
extension_properties.assertion: Unknown HTTP routes return HOLD/404 rather than implicit success.

extension_properties.name: Version-bounded applied retraction
extension_properties.assertion: The v0.2 HTTP surface remains fail-closed for applied retraction; v0.3 enables it only through the durable transition/rollback contract.

extension_properties.name: Immutable base claim under retraction
extension_properties.assertion: Applied retraction changes only an effective-governance-state overlay; canonical base Claim bytes remain unchanged.

extension_properties.name: Dependency-only retraction propagation
extension_properties.assertion: Retraction suspends only declared dependency descendants. Contradiction links are reported but never traversed as dependency edges.

extension_properties.name: Durable restart recovery
extension_properties.assertion: Node snapshots and effective-state overlays survive local process restart in the SQLite candidate.

extension_properties.name: Rollback predecessor restoration
extension_properties.assertion: Rollback is append-only in history and restores predecessor effective states when affected claims have not received a conflicting later transition.

extension_properties.name: State-root compare-and-swap
extension_properties.assertion: A stale expected state root causes HOLD/conflict before transition mutation.

extension_properties.name: Overlapping transition conflict
extension_properties.assertion: A claim cannot participate in overlapping active transition overlays; ambiguity fails closed.

extension_properties.name: Persistent HTTP mutation
extension_properties.assertion: Local HTTP registration, applied retraction, restart recovery and rollback are persistence-bound in the v0.3 candidate.
